And the movable cross is the one with the white core.

The movable cross is the one with the white core... but then which cross collects the yellow squares? The yellow cross (which is yellow-colored).

Actually, the core color might indicate which color that cross is "charged" with, and the cross can only collect squares of the same color as its core? Hmm, but then the blue cross can't collect blue squares until it has a blue core... but after SPACE, the blue cross got a blue core.
Alternatively, the white core might mean "empty/active." Let me test: move the yellow cross (currently active) to a yellow square and see what happens.
